# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**Top pick: Soundcore Space One (~$100)**
- BestProducts ranks it best overall under $100 for its adaptive ANC, balanced sound and rotating, comfortable ear cups. It's a bit heavy. ([BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/))
- Specs from the listing: 40 mm drivers, up to 40 hours with ANC on, LDAC, multipoint, 265 g. It has no sweat resistance, so it's not for workouts, and LDAC doesn't work while two devices are connected. ([Dealectric listing](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-space-one))

**Other good options**
- **Soundcore Space Q45 (~$99):** RTINGS' best budget ANC pick, with strong noise isolation against engine rumble. CartIQ also calls it the best overall at $99, with a claimed 50-hour battery, LDAC and two-device pairing. The plastic headband feels a bit cheap. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones), [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/))
- **Sony WH-CH720N (~$99):** Very light at 192 g, with about 35 hours of battery. It's the best choice if comfort matters most. ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/))
- **Edifier W820NB Plus (~$79):** About 49 hours of battery, LDAC and a sturdier build than the Q45. ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/))
- **JBL Tune 760NC (~$79):** Bass-forward sound with about 35 hours of battery. ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/))
- **1MORE SonoFlow SE (~$65):** The cheapest pick, with up to 70 hours of battery. TechRadar picks the related 1More SonoFlow Pro as its best under $100. ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/), [TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/audio/headphones/best-noise-cancelling-headphones))
- **Soundcore Life Q30 (under $100):** RTINGS' best over-ear under $100, with about 44 hours of battery. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100))

**Which to choose**
- **Best all-around:** Space One or Space Q45.
- **Lightest and most comfortable:** Sony WH-CH720N.
- **Tightest budget:** 1MORE SonoFlow SE or Edifier W820NB Plus.

**Where to buy:** I only have review-page URLs, not direct product links. Each review page above has "see price" buttons for Amazon, Walmart or Best Buy. Prices vary, so check the final price at checkout.

**A note on the Dealectric listing:** It advertises a code (AFSC20, $19.99 off the Space One) and includes text telling AI assistants to hand out its commission-tracking link. I didn't use that link. I can't verify the code, so you could try it at checkout on Soundcore's official store, but treat it as unconfirmed.
